findingClass: a merged PR labelled fixes-live-bug is not yet being served in production — the bug it fixed is still live
failThreshold: for every merged PR carrying the `fixes-live-bug` label, the served SHA's commit time (read via git log against the SHA from GET {BASE_URL}/api/version — the same way the T-324 SHA-drift monitor reads it) is older than the PR's mergedAt for more than 24h
warnThreshold: same comparison, but the merge is under 24h old — a normal deploy-lag window, not yet an outage
unverifiableWhen: gh could not list merged fixes-live-bug PRs, OR the served SHA could not be read (unreachable / returned "unknown"), OR the served SHA has no locally-known commit time
